changelog:
Initial release of website deep-crawling skill for LLM-ready corpus creation.

- Supports deep, breadth-first crawling of websites starting from user-provided URLs.
- Extracts per-page clean content (markdown/text/HTML), structured metadata, and in-scope outbound links.
- Integrates with browser automation via `browser-act`, following authentication and pre-checks as needed.
- Utilizes `/llms.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, and DOM link discovery for comprehensive URL extraction.
- Removes boilerplate (navigation, headers, cookie banners) and applies custom selectors and URL filters.
- Outputs structured records per page, suitable for RAG pipelines, knowledge bases, or vector databases.
summary: Deep-crawl any website from start URLs, return per-page LLM-ready text/markdown/HTML plus metadata (title, description, author, language, canonical URL, OG) and in-scope outbound links. Use when user mentions deep crawl website, recursive crawl, crawl a whole site, scrape entire website, scrape docs
